sections.heading: Error code catalog
sections.text: Use these error codes when classifying payment failures during ops investigations.

sections.heading: GATEWAY_TIMEOUT
sections.text: The method processor did not respond. Typical during UPI or card-network brownouts. Ops action: fail over and page the processor.

sections.heading: INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS
sections.text: Issuer decline. Not an incident unless it spikes across many issuers.

sections.heading: DO_NOT_HONOR
sections.text: Generic issuer decline. Investigate only if concentrated on one acquirer.

sections.heading: AUTHENTICATION_FAILED
sections.text: Customer 3DS or UPI PIN failure. Not a platform outage.

sections.heading: WEBHOOK_TIMEOUT
sections.text: Consumer did not ACK. The payment may still have succeeded.
